pronunciation.approximation: Say "ahriman" with the stress and length implied by the scholarly restoration "Ahriman".
pronunciation.note: The ASCII form "ahriman" is a DNS compromise; the restoration "Ahriman" preserves the name's scholarly dignity.

domains.title: Ahriman
domains.subtitle: Evil
domains.lead: Ahriman is evil, destruction, lies. The name means "Evil spirit, destructive mind" and belongs to the zoroastrian tradition.

cards.name: Sacred Name
cards.desc: The restoration Ahriman returns the figure to scholarly recognition.

cards.name: Living Tradition
cards.desc: Honored in zoroastrian myth, cult, and cultural memory.

cards.name: Unicode Restoration
cards.desc: Preserved as a flagship temple despite the unregistrable plain-ASCII form.

symbols.name: Name
symbols.meaning: The restored form Ahriman, carrying scholarly and cultural weight.

mythology.lead: The stories of Ahriman place evil, destruction, lies at the center of a living mythological world.

myths.title: Origins
myths.text: Ahriman appears in zoroastrian tradition as evil, destruction, lies. The name's meaning, "Evil spirit, destructive mind", shapes the narratives told about this figure.

myths.title: Worship and Memory
myths.text: Devotees and later tradition-keepers preserved Ahriman in ritual, text, and iconography, ensuring the name survived into the modern scholarly record.

lore.culturalLegacy: Ahriman remains a touchstone for understanding zoroastrian religion, art, and identity.
